topic: Teardown: Scaling organic inbound without paid ads
hook: Analyzing sustainable organic inbound architecture without paid ad spend.
body:
High-signal B2B founder growth consistently follows these 3 non-negotiables:

• Documented client objections verbatim in a 'Story Bank'
• Published recurring teardowns with specific architectural trade-offs
• Commented thoughtfully on prospective buyer posts daily before pitching

No hacks. Just consistent execution of high-signal craft.
call_to_action: Which of these 3 habits is hardest for your team to maintain?
